title: Fix Forbidden Web Sys Js Sys Deps In Sequence And Flow Extension Bim Plugins
description: Fix forbidden web-sys and js-sys direct dependencies in plugin crates semio-s-plugin-sequence and semio-s-plugin-flow-extension-bim
summary: Fixed forbidden web-sys and js-sys direct dependencies in semio-s-plugin-flow-extension-bim and semio-s-plugin-sequence plugin crates. Removed unused js-sys from flow-extension-bim manifest. Relocated sequence's WASM canvas session glue from semio-s-plugin-sequence to semio-s-app-sequence-ui, stripping web-sys/js-sys from semio-s-plugin-sequence. Cleared KNOWN_CAPABILITY_VIOLATIONS entries in script.ts and verified bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-os-dev:plugin lint passes with 36 positive evaluated plugin packages.
